purpose: Explain that an intense feeling or state caused a result.
keywords: give explain a reason cause result
express feelings speak politely show respect
Noun + のあまり; verb plain form + あまり
I was so surprised that I could not speak.
I was so delighted about passing that I forgot our appointment.
I was so nervous that I said my name incorrectly.
formation: Noun + のあまり; verb plain form + あまり
restrictions: The cause is unusually strong, often leading to an unintended outcome.
mistake: For ordinary reasons use ので; あまり emphasizes excess.
